name: Classic masala
ingredients: Rolled Oats (55.5%), Millets (16%) [Jowar flare), Bajra flakes (2%)], Maltodextrin, lodised Salt, Spices and Condiments-, Dried Vegetables (Carrots (1.15%), Onion - Flakes (1.15%), Green Peas (0.69% ) ), Sugar, Starch, Refined Rice Bran Oil, Natural Flavouring Substances, Hydrolysed Vegetable protein, Flavour Enhances ( 627, INS 631), Nature-identical Flavouring Substances. Contains Onions, Turmeric, Pepper, Red Chill, Cumin, Garlic, Fenugreek, Clove, Nutmeg. ALLERGEN ADVICE: Contains Oats, Soy & Sulphite, May contain trace of Milk & other Gluten containing cereals
